reviews.x: These are awesome little cloth towels.  The scent is very mild.  I tried the Lavender and the Peach Mango also. I think the Lavender is my favorite but they all smell delicious. I will warn you to do just a few seconds in microwave.  They warm up fast.  The bag will burst open.  It doesn't hurt anything, but just be prepared.

reviews.x: I used to love the citrus travel towelettes from Crabtree and Evelyn that were discontinued several years ago.  I tried every substitute that I could find.  Finally I have found something that I really like.  I live in the South and carry these the lemon towelettes in my bag at all times.  They are a great way to refresh on a warm day.  Love the scent. Also, they are made of a decent sized piece of cloth rather than paper and don't ittitate or dry out my skin.

These are superb for weddings or any other fancy buffet type event, especially barbecue! Made of very thin real cotton terrycloth material, they are moist but not too wet and have a pleasant natural lemon scent that does not over power food or linger too long after use. The mango scented ones were too strong and sweet smelling for my taste but many of the women at or event liked them. Really great product!

Got these for our lobster bake wedding. These were THE BIGGEST HIT of the night. They smelled amazing and did a great job of cleaning up after eating lobster. Everyone kept asking where they were from. One cloth was enough per person which means we over estimated and had a lot leftover. However, I am sure these will come in handy. We will probably start using them to clean our dogs paws when they come in with muddy feet.

I love these little bits of on the go luxury. It is a real cotton towel. The scent is not overpowering (in fact I wish it were a touch stronger, but it's good enough). I keep some in my purse for pre/post meal clean-ups of kids or when I'm on long flights and want to clean up a bit before arriving.
They are pretty good, but could be a little larger and more damp.  They are definitely acceptable and would be fine for an event such as a wedding, etc.  I may buy them again, not sure yet.

We also toss a bunch of them into the cooler when we go to the beach or outdoor summer concerts.  The lemon scent appeals to both males and females.  We haven't experienced the "drying out" other reviewers have experienced, even six months out.  Love these!

reviews.x: These towelettes are great.  We pack them in our bags everywhere we go.  Once used the towels can be reused for anything from wiping down implements to your fact.  Small enough to put in a purse, backpack, etc. and so far the packets do not leak so they are strong enough to tote around.

We offer these towels to our dental patients after a procedure and they love them.  It allows them to freshen up before heading back to work or elsewhere.  They are soft, smell nice and just the right size. It is our way of letting our patients know how much we care about them too.

Great for travel! We’ve used this every time we travel internationally. Most places give you the little risky dink, thin napkins, where you feel like you need to ask for the whole package (we have kids). If you have kids and travel, you need this 😊

I use these for patients at my office.  Everyone loves the lemon ones.  Stick them in the fridge during the hot summer for a nice refreshing treat, or stick them in a warmer during the winter (they do get a little dry in the warmer).

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the pleasant, mild scent that doesn't overwhelm.
Many customers find these handy for travel, carrying in purses or cars, and using hot or cold.
Several reviewers say the cloths work well for cleaning up after messy foods or events like weddings and barbecues.
Some customers appreciate that these are real reusable cotton cloths rather than thin paper wipes.
One reviewer reported receiving thin cloths with holes, a quality concern.
